fields.statement: At 1929007, go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/run-ship-needs-leaves -count=1 passes: on a change set with no leaves `rhiza run start --workflow ship-change` exits non-zero with 'has no leaves' and 'rhiza run start --workflow plan' on stderr (and "next": "rhiza run start --workflow plan" under --json), no .git/rhiza/runs and no worktree for the change set; after adding a capability the same command prints 'Run <id> succeeded' and journals the run. Read internal/api/run.go: checkShipLeaves runs in runRunStart before newRunID, t.open (worktree) and run.Start, so nothing is written on refusal. The 1929007 fix only renames the leaf's statement/acceptance to `run start --workflow plan`, matching the code. make check exits 0.
